meta.title: Piano to MIDI
meta.description: Upload a piano recording and get an editable MIDI file with notes, dynamics and pedal. Tune the transcription by hand or let it pick the settings.

home.title: New recording
home.lead: Upload a piano recording and get a MIDI file with the notes, dynamics and pedal, ready to edit in a DAW.

footer.privacy: Recordings and the resulting MIDI files are kept only for a while and deleted automatically an hour after they were last opened.

upload.formats: MP3, M4A, WAV, FLAC or OGG
upload.limits: MP3, M4A, WAV, FLAC or OGG, up to {mb} MB and {minutes} minutes

recent.title: Recent recordings
recent.note: Recordings disappear an hour after they were last opened.

errors.not_audio: That doesn't look like an audio file. Try MP3, M4A, WAV, FLAC or OGG.
errors.too_long: The recording is longer than {minutes} minutes.
errors.empty: The recording is empty or too short.
errors.busy: Too many recordings are waiting. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check the connection and try again.
errors.expired: This transcription no longer exists: they're deleted an hour after the last visit.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on the server. Try again.

job.waiting: {n} recording ahead of yours… | {n} recordings ahead of yours…

result.confirmDelete: Delete it now? Otherwise it goes by itself an hour after your last visit.

roll.label: Piano roll: {notes} notes over {time}
roll.overview: Whole piece: drag the frame to move the view

player.noOriginal: The recording is only kept in the tab you uploaded it from.
player.midiNote: MIDI is played by a simple built-in synthesizer, to check notes and timing; in a DAW it will sound like your chosen piano.
